description: Groz Heavy Duty Long Arm Hand Riveter is an ideal tool for use in ship building, machine manufacturing, on-shore & off-shore fabrication jobs, infrastructure projects, agriculture equipment manufacturing etc. It comes with a built in mandrel collector which collects rivets, protecting workers from rivets and keeping the workspace clean. It has fewer moving parts that leads to less wear and tear, thus making it virtually maintenance free. It comes with heavy duty steel handle & die cast aluminium body that make it rigid, corrosion resistant and long lasting. It can be used with most popular sized stainless steel and aluminum rivets that can be changed easily with wrench. Ideal for riveting: a.
